title: The Plague Stops After Aaron's Atonement
description: The day after Korah's rebellion, the whole congregation complained against Moses and Aaron, saying that they had killed the people of the Lord. The glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting, and a plague broke out among the people. Moses told Aaron to take his firepan with fire from the altar and incense, and hurry out to the congregation to make atonement. Aaron ran into the midst of the assembly and stood between the dead and the living, and the plague stopped. Fourteen thousand seven hundred died, besides those who died because of Korah.
